title: PlanFlip：针对多智能体LLM系统的规划阶段提示注入攻击
summary: 本文提出PlanFlip框架，包含四种针对多智能体LLM系统规划阶段的提示注入攻击方法。实验发现：更强的模型（如GPT-5）反而更脆弱；同质化流水线存在相关智能体盲点；推理增强模型（如DeepSeek-R1）能抵抗注入。提出两种检测方法，在15/16个测试单元中优于基线。核心见解：异构模型多样性是多智能体系统的安全前提。
summary_en: Introduces PlanFlip, a framework of four planning-phase prompt injection attacks on multi-agent LLM systems. Key findings: stronger models (e.g., GPT-5) are more vulnerable; homogeneous pipelines have correlated-agent blind spots; reasoning-augmented models resist injections. Proposes two detection methods outperforming baselines in 15/16 cells. Core insight: heterogeneous model diversity is a security prerequisite.
